title: RocketRide server settings
description: Optional provider keys for LLM nodes. The featured document pipelines and the MCP tools for building and validating pipelines work without any keys. Keys are stored encrypted and passed to the engine as environment variables; they never leave your run.

additionalEnv.title: Other node credentials
additionalEnv.description: Any other ROCKETRIDE_* variables your pipelines reference, e.g. {"ROCKETRIDE_QDRANT_HOST": "...", "ROCKETRIDE_COHERE_KEY": "..."}. Names must start with ROCKETRIDE_.

warmFeaturedPipelines.title: Pre-warm featured pipelines
warmFeaturedPipelines.description: Start the doc-to-text and redact-pii pipelines when the server boots, so the first request is fast.

verboseLogging.title: Verbose engine logs
verboseLogging.description: Run the engine with --verbose for debugging.
